d: Long, straight ash-blonde hair with blunt-cut bangs, adorned by a large blue and black ribbon bow on top. A single visible eye is a bright sapphire blue with a gentle, smiling expression. The face appears young and adolescent with a soft, youthful maturity. A slender build wearing a blue puff-sleeved dress under a white ruffled apron, accessorized with a black choker and a red and black necktie. A white medical eyepatch covers the right eye.
